title: Celestial Face Nebula
description: A surreal cosmic portrait of a woman's face emerging from swirling teal and purple nebulae, with one visible blue eye and pink lips. Multiple textured golden, pink, and dark spherical celestial bodies orbit around her, connected by flowing golden and magenta ribbons against a dark cloudy space background.
